Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Basic
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.TimeConstructible
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.InputLength
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.VirtualInput
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Seam
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Bin
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.Transducer
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.WordTests

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Space-constructible functions

[AB09, §4.1, p. 79]: `S : ℕ → ℕ` is space-constructible when some machine
computes `S(|x|)` from `x` within `O(S(|x|))` space, and the book's standing
convention is `S(n) > log n`. The definition mirrors
`Complexity.TimeConstructible` — output in binary (`Nat.bits`), constant slack
`c · S n`, which implements the book's own asymptotic space convention
([AB09, p. 79]: "computes `S(|x|)` in `O(S(|x|))` space"); an exact-space
variant is not posed here (the exact-**time** refutation of chapter 1 does not
transfer: a space deadline forces no premature halt) — and carries the book's
convention as the conjunct `∀ n, logSpace n ≤ S n`, so that downstream
statements (the space hierarchy, Savitch) can draw on it without restating it;
results needing only weaker hypotheses must say so.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.SpaceConstructible` — the binary-output, constant-slack,
  above-log form. [AB09, §4.1, p. 79]

## Main results (proved)

* `Complexity.spaceConstructible_iff` — the definition as an equivalence.
* `Complexity.spaceConstructible_logSpace` — `log` is space-constructible.
* `Complexity.spaceConstructible_linear` — `n + 1` is space-constructible.
* `Complexity.spaceConstructible_poly` — `n ^ c + 1` is space-constructible for `c ≥ 1`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1, p. 79.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing

/-- A function `S` is **space-constructible** when it dominates the logarithm
(`Complexity.logSpace`, the book's standing `S(n) > log n` convention carried as
data) and some machine computes the binary representation of `S (|x|)` from `x`
within `c · S (|x|)` visited work-tape cells. Mirrors
`Complexity.TimeConstructible` (binary output via `Nat.bits`, constant slack).
[AB09, §4.1, p. 79] -/
def SpaceConstructible (S : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ n, logSpace n ≤ S n) ∧
  ∃ c : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool,
    M.ComputesInSpace (fun x => (S x.length).bits) fun n => c * S n

/-- **Space constructibility, unfolded**: `S` is space constructible exactly when
`logSpace n ≤ S n` for every `n` and, for some constant `c > 0`, some machine computes
`x ↦ (S |x|).bits` in space `c · S` (`Turing.FinTM.ComputesInSpace`). -/
theorem spaceConstructible_iff (S : ℕ → ℕ) :
    SpaceConstructible S ↔
      (∀ n, logSpace n ≤ S n) ∧ ∃ c : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool,
        M.ComputesInSpace (fun x => (S x.length).bits) fun n => c * S n :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Positive binary words have exactly the normalized logarithmic width. -/
private lemma b3a_bits_length {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n.bits.length = logSpace n :=
  (LogProg.length_bits_eq_log hn).trans (logSpace_eq n).symm

/-- The counter word with its first cell overwritten by `true`. -/
private def b3a_word (n : ℕ) : List Bool := true :: n.bits.tail

/-- The overwrite handles zero while preserving every positive counter width. -/
private lemma b3a_word_length (n : ℕ) : (b3a_word n).length = logSpace n := by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp [b3a_word, logSpace, Nat.bits]
  · simp only [b3a_word, List.length_cons, List.length_tail, b3a_bits_length hn]
    unfold logSpace
    omega

/-- Restricting a buffer to its occupied nonnegative interval does not change it. -/
private lemma b3a_buffer_restrict (w : List Bool) (z : ℤ) :
    (if 0 ≤ z ∧ z < (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape w z else none) =
      FinTM.bufferTape w z := by
  by_cases hzero : 0 ≤ z
  · by_cases hlast : z < (w.length : ℤ)
    · simp [hzero, hlast]
    · have out : w.length ≤ z.toNat := by omega
      simp [hzero, hlast, FinTM.bufferTape]
  · simp [hzero, FinTM.bufferTape]

/-- Setting the first buffered cell yields `true :: tail`, including an empty buffer. -/
private lemma b3a_buffer_overwrite (w : List Bool) (z : ℤ) :
    (if z = 0 then some true else FinTM.bufferTape w z) =
      FinTM.bufferTape (true :: w.tail) z := by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    simp [FinTM.bufferTape]
  · by_cases hp : 0 ≤ z
    · have ht : z.toNat ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp only [if_neg hz, FinTM.bufferTape, if_pos hp, List.getElem?_cons,
        if_neg ht, List.getElem?_tail]
      congr 1
      omega
    · simp [hz, FinTM.bufferTape, hp]

/-- A live phase seam: its word is on tape zero and all heads are at the origin. -/
private def b3a_cfg {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {S : Type} (s : S)
    (x w : List Bool) : Cfg k Bool S x :=
  { Cfg.init s x with
    workTapes := fun j => if j = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape w else fun _ => none }

/-- Map only the control field of a canonical phase seam. -/
private lemma b3a_cfg_map {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {S T : Type} (f : S → T)
    (s : S) (x w : List Bool) :
    (b3a_cfg (k := k) s x w).mapState f = b3a_cfg (f s) x w := rfl

/-- Relocate a single-buffer seam along a selection preserving tape zero.
**Proof sketch.** Selected tapes use the public configuration projections;
other tapes use the frame theorem at time zero. All unused cells and heads are blank. -/
private lemma b3a_embed_cfg {m k : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero k] {S : Type}
    (R : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (hzero : ι 0 = 0)
    (s : S) (x w : List Bool) :
    embedEmitCfg ι (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (b3a_cfg s x w) =
      b3a_cfg (k := k) s x w := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext j
    by_cases chosen : j ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := chosen
      rw [embedEmitCfg_selected_tape]
      have hz : ι i = 0 ↔ i = 0 := by rw [← hzero, ι.injective.eq_iff]
      simp only [b3a_cfg, hz]
    · have frame := (embedEmitTM_frame ι R (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
        [] (b3a_cfg s x w) 0).1 j chosen
      have hj : j ≠ 0 := fun eq => chosen ⟨0, hzero.trans eq.symm⟩
      simpa [b3a_cfg, hj] using frame.1
  · funext j
    by_cases chosen : j ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := chosen
      rw [embedEmitCfg_selected_pos]
      rfl
    · exact (embedEmitTM_frame ι R (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
        [] (b3a_cfg s x w) 0).1 j chosen |>.2
  · rfl

/-- A coarse constant-factor space bound for tape relocation.
**Proof sketch.** Every selected tape is bounded by the source's total space;
each unused tape contributes one cell. Sum this common bound over the host bank. -/
private lemma b3a_embed_space {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (R : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
    (d : Cfg m Bool S x) (t : ℕ) :
    (embedEmitTM ι R).spaceUsed
        (embedEmitCfg ι (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] d) t ≤
      k * (R.spaceUsed d t + 1) := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin k, (R.spaceUsed d t + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      by_cases chosen : j ∈ Set.range ι
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := chosen
        rw [(embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead ι R (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] d t i).2]
        exact (R.spaceUsedByTape_le_spaceUsed d t i).trans (Nat.le_succ _)
      · rw [(embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_frame ι R (fun _ _ => none)
          (fun _ => 0) [] d t j chosen).2]
        omega
    _ = _ := by simp [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed]

/-- The additive space ledger for an arbitrary live-exit seam: the general seam space lemma
`Turing.seamCompTM_spaceUsed_le_add_ofCfg`, with this file's argument names. -/
private lemma b3a_seam_space {k : ℕ} {S T : Type} [DecidableEq S] {x : List Bool}
    (R : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (exit : S) (Q : MultiTapeTM k Bool T) (entry : T)
    {d e : Cfg k Bool S x} {a b : ℕ} (run : R.runFrom d a = e)
    (live : e.state = some exit) (cut : ∀ u < a, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) :
    (seamCompTM R exit Q entry).spaceUsed (d.mapState Sum.inl) (a + 1 + b) ≤
      R.spaceUsed d a + Q.spaceUsed (e.mapState fun _ => entry) b :=
  seamCompTM_spaceUsed_le_add_ofCfg R exit Q entry run live cut

/-- The public native counter, specialized to blank origin tapes with a cardinality ledger.
**Proof sketch.** Instantiate R8.5c at its entry, identify the globally blank frame
with the buffer layout, and enclose each head's visited set in the promised interval.
The first-exit clause is retained for the subsequent dispatch. -/
private theorem b3a_counter :
    ∃ (K : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S)
      (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool S) (entry exit : S) (B : ℕ),
      ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t,
        R.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) t = b3a_cfg exit x x.length.bits ∧
        (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
        R.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg entry x []) t ≤ B * (x.length.bits.length + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨K, S, fs, ds, R, entry, exit, C, contract⟩ := exists_inputLengthTM
  letI := fs
  letI := ds
  refine ⟨K, S, fs, ds, R, entry, exit, (K + 1) * (2 * C + 1), ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, _, cut, heads, finished⟩ := contract (b3a_cfg entry x []) rfl rfl
    (by intros; simp [b3a_cfg]) (by intros; simp [b3a_cfg])
  refine ⟨t, ?_, cut, ?_⟩
  · rw [finished]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext j z
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · simp [b3a_cfg, hj, b3a_buffer_restrict]
      · simp [b3a_cfg, hj]
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · have perTape (j : Fin (K + 1)) : R.spaceUsedByTape (b3a_cfg entry x []) t j ≤
        2 * (C * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) + 1 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (Finset.Icc (-((C * (x.length.bits.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ))
            ((C * (x.length.bits.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)).card := by
          apply Finset.card_le_card
          intro z hz
          obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
          have bound := heads u (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hu)) j
          simpa [b3a_cfg, Finset.mem_Icc, abs_le] using bound
        _ = _ := by rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin (K + 1), (2 * (C * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) + 1) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => perTape j
      _ = (K + 1) * (2 * (C * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) + 1) := by simp
      _ ≤ (K + 1) * ((2 * C + 1) * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) := by
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
        ring_nf; omega
      _ = _ := by ring

/-- The public constant writer overwrites cell zero and returns to its origin.
**Proof sketch.** Use R8.4 with `[true]`. Its four-step trace supplies the exact
exit cut and two-cell head interval; the buffer update is the tail identity above. -/
private theorem b3a_overwrite (x w : List Bool) :
    (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]).runFrom (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) 4 =
        b3a_cfg .done x (true :: w.tail) ∧
      (∀ u < 4, ((writeConstTM 1 0 [true]).runFrom
        (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) u).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]).spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) 4 ≤ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, heads⟩ := writeConstTM_run_ofCfg (0 : Fin 1) [true]
    (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) rfl
  norm_num only [List.length_singleton] at run
  refine ⟨?_, cut, ?_⟩
  · rw [run]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext j z
      have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [b3a_cfg, Cfg.init, hj, if_pos, List.length_singleton,
        zero_add, sub_zero]
      simp only [true_and, show (0 ≤ z ∧ z < 1) ↔ z = 0 by omega]
      by_cases hz : z = 0
      · simp [hz, FinTM.bufferTape]
      · simpa [hz] using b3a_buffer_overwrite w z
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · change ∑ j : Fin 1, _ ≤ 2
    rw [Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin 1)]
    calc
      _ ≤ (Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) 1).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
        simpa [b3a_cfg] using heads 0 u (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hu))
      _ = 2 := by decide

/-- The emitting phase shares tape zero and places its bank after the native counter bank. -/
private def b3a_virtualSelect (K m : ℕ) : Fin (1 + m) ↪ Fin (K + 1 + m) where
  toFun i := ⟨if i.val = 0 then 0 else K + i.val, by split_ifs <;> omega⟩
  inj' := by
    intro i j eq
    apply Fin.ext
    have vals := congrArg Fin.val eq
    dsimp at vals
    split_ifs at vals <;> omega

/-- The initial virtual-input layout is the single-buffer phase seam.
**Proof sketch.** Split the host tapes into its buffer and source bank. The source
starts at input position one, with blank work tapes and all heads at zero. -/
private lemma b3a_virtual_cfg (L : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) :
    vhostCfg (L.tm.initCfg y) true (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) [] =
      b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext j z
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      have zero : Fin.castAdd L.k (0 : Fin 1) = 0 := rfl
      change FinTM.bufferTape y z =
        (if Fin.castAdd L.k (0 : Fin 1) = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape y else fun _ => none) z
      rw [if_pos zero]
    · have nonzero : Fin.natAdd 1 i ≠ (0 : Fin (1 + L.k)) := by
        intro eq
        have vals := congrArg Fin.val eq
        simp only [Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.val_zero] at vals
        omega
      simp only [vhostCfg, Fin.addCases_right, b3a_cfg, if_neg nonzero,
        MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
  · funext j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp [vhostCfg, b3a_cfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
    · simp [vhostCfg, b3a_cfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
  · rfl

/-- Assemble the three public phases with an explicit boundary-inclusive space allowance.
**Proof sketch.** Count on a native bank, overwrite its first cell, then host the
length counter on that word. Both seams dispatch at their first exits. The public
relocation and seam ledgers bound total space by a fixed multiple of the normalized
logarithm plus one; the final virtual-input halt emits the full binary answer. -/
private theorem b3a_log_machine :
    ∃ (A : ℕ), 0 < A ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool,
      M.ComputesInSpace (fun x => (logSpace x.length).bits)
        (fun n => A * (logSpace n + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨K, S, fs, ds, R, entry, exit, B, counter⟩ := b3a_counter
  letI := fs
  letI := ds
  obtain ⟨L, b, computes, space⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed
  let k := K + 1 + L.k
  let ic : Fin (K + 1) ↪ Fin k := Fin.castAddEmb L.k
  let iw : Fin 1 ↪ Fin k := Fin.castLEEmb (by dsimp [k]; omega)
  let iv := b3a_virtualSelect K L.k
  have ic0 : ic 0 = 0 := rfl
  have iw0 : iw 0 = 0 := rfl
  have iv0 : iv 0 = 0 := by apply Fin.ext; simp [iv, b3a_virtualSelect]
  let C := embedEmitTM ic R
  let W := embedEmitTM iw (writeConstTM 1 0 [true])
  let E := embedEmitTM iv (vhostEmitTM L.tm)
  let CW := seamCompTM C exit W (.wr 0)
  let H := seamCompTM CW (Sum.inr .done) E (L.tm.q₀, true)
  let M : FinTM Bool :=
    { k := k
      State := (S ⊕ WritePhase 1) ⊕ (L.State × Bool)
      tm := {H with q₀ := Sum.inl (Sum.inl entry)} }
  refine ⟨k * (B + b + 8) + 1, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let y := b3a_word x.length
  obtain ⟨t, counted, countCut, countSpace⟩ := counter x
  obtain ⟨written, writeCut, writeSpace⟩ := b3a_overwrite x x.length.bits
  -- Count and overwrite share the buffer; their first-exit cuts justify both dispatches.
  have countRun : C.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) t =
      b3a_cfg exit x x.length.bits := by
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0 entry x [], embedEmitTM_runFrom, counted,
      b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0]
  have countFirst : ∀ u < t, (C.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) u).state ≠ some exit := by
    intro u hu
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0 entry x [], embedEmitTM_runFrom]
    exact countCut u hu
  have writeRun : W.runFrom (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4 =
      b3a_cfg .done x y := by
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0 (.wr 0) x x.length.bits,
      embedEmitTM_runFrom, written, b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0]
    rfl
  have writeFirst : ∀ u < 4,
      (W.runFrom (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) u).state ≠ some .done := by
    intro u hu
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0 (.wr 0) x x.length.bits,
      embedEmitTM_runFrom]
    exact writeCut u hu
  have cwRun : CW.runFrom (b3a_cfg (Sum.inl entry) x []) (t + 1 + 4) =
      b3a_cfg (Sum.inr .done) x y := by
    simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using seamCompTM_run_ofCfg C exit W (.wr 0)
      countRun rfl countFirst (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using writeRun)
  have cwFirst : ∀ u < t + 1 + 4,
      (CW.runFrom (b3a_cfg (Sum.inl entry) x []) u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr .done) := by
    simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg C exit W (.wr 0) .done
      countRun rfl countFirst (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using writeRun) rfl
      (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using writeFirst)
  -- The last phase forwards the hosted counter's full output, including its halting step.
  let u := b * (y.length + 1)
  have tag : FinTM.VirtualTag (L.tm.initCfg y).inputPos true := by
    simp [FinTM.VirtualTag, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
  obtain ⟨tagEnd, _, hosted⟩ := vhostEmitTM_runFrom L.tm (L.tm.initCfg y) true tag
    (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) [] u
  have emitted : E.runFrom (b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y) u =
      embedEmitCfg iv (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
        (vhostCfg (L.tm.runFrom (L.tm.initCfg y) u) tagEnd (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) []) := by
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg (vhostEmitTM L.tm) iv iv0 (L.tm.q₀, true) x y,
      ← b3a_virtual_cfg, embedEmitTM_runFrom, hosted]
  have fullRun := seamCompTM_run_ofCfg CW (Sum.inr .done) E (L.tm.q₀, true)
    cwRun rfl cwFirst (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using emitted)
  have start : M.tm.initCfg x = b3a_cfg (Sum.inl (Sum.inl entry)) x [] := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [M, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, b3a_cfg, Cfg.init]
  refine ⟨(t + 1 + 4) + 1 + u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    rw [start]
    change (H.runFrom _ _).state = none ∧ (H.runFrom _ _).output = _
    rw [show b3a_cfg (Sum.inl (Sum.inl entry)) x [] =
      (b3a_cfg (Sum.inl entry) x []).mapState Sum.inl from rfl, fullRun]
    obtain ⟨halted, output⟩ := (FinTM.computesInTime_iff L y _ u).mp (computes y)
    simp only [Cfg.mapState, embedEmitCfg, vhostCfg, List.nil_append,
      halted, output, Option.map_none, y, b3a_word_length, and_self]
  · rw [start]
    change H.spaceUsed _ _ ≤ _
    -- Add the three boundary-inclusive ledgers before absorbing the constant slack.
    have firstLedger := b3a_seam_space C exit W (.wr 0) (b := 4)
      countRun rfl countFirst
    have lastLedger := b3a_seam_space CW (Sum.inr .done) E (L.tm.q₀, true) (b := u)
      cwRun rfl cwFirst
    simp only [b3a_cfg_map] at firstLedger lastLedger
    have cSpace := b3a_embed_space R ic (b3a_cfg entry x []) t
    rw [b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0] at cSpace
    have wSpace := b3a_embed_space (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw
      (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4
    rw [b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0] at wSpace
    have eSpace := b3a_embed_space (vhostEmitTM L.tm) iv
      (vhostCfg (L.tm.initCfg y) true (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) []) u
    rw [b3a_virtual_cfg, b3a_embed_cfg (vhostEmitTM L.tm) iv iv0] at eSpace
    have eSource := vhostEmitTM_spaceUsed_le L.tm (L.tm.initCfg y) true tag
      (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) [] u
    rw [b3a_virtual_cfg] at eSource
    have sizeBound : Nat.size y.length ≤ y.length := by
      rw [← Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
      exact length_bits_le_self _
    have width := LogProg.length_bits_le_log x.length
    have yLength : y.length = logSpace x.length := b3a_word_length _
    have nativeBound : C.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg entry x []) t ≤
        k * (B * (logSpace x.length + 1) + 1) := by
      apply cSpace.trans
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      apply Nat.add_le_add_right
      exact countSpace.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left B (Nat.add_le_add_right width 1))
    have writerBound : W.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4 ≤ k * 3 := by
      exact wSpace.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))
    have emitterBound : E.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y) u ≤
        k * (b * (logSpace x.length + 1) + logSpace x.length + 3) := by
      apply eSpace.trans
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      have ls := space y u
      have bound := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b (Nat.add_le_add_right sizeBound 1))
      rw [yLength] at bound eSource ls
      omega
    calc
      _ ≤ C.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg entry x []) t +
          W.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4 +
          E.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y) u :=
        lastLedger.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right firstLedger _)
      _ ≤ k * (B * (logSpace x.length + 1) + 1) + k * 3 +
          k * (b * (logSpace x.length + 1) + logSpace x.length + 3) := by
        exact Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add nativeBound writerBound) emitterBound
      _ ≤ (k * (B + b + 8) + 1) * (logSpace x.length + 1) := by
        ring_nf; omega

/-- **The logarithm is space-constructible.** [AB09, p. 79: "all functions of
interest, including `log n`, …, are space-constructible"]

**Proof sketch.** Fill obligations: a machine that (i) counts the input length
in binary on a work tape by one left-to-right input scan with a binary
increment at each step (the `Turing.counterTM`/`incrementTM` idiom — P11 of
`machine-library-design.md` §4, space-annotated per §12 R3) — the counter word
has `|Nat.bits n| = logSpace n` cells **for `n > 0` only** (`Nat.bits 0 = []`
has length `0 ≠ logSpace 0 = 1`), so (ii) the empty
input is special-cased to emit `(logSpace 0).bits = [true]` directly, and
otherwise the machine computes the counter word's bit-length by a second count
and emits its bits. Space: the counters and markers fit in
`A·(logSpace n + 1) ≤ 2A·logSpace n` visited cells (boundary cells included
before absorbing, since `logSpace n ≥ 1`); the dominance conjunct is `le_refl`
at `S = logSpace`.

**Fill appendix.** The empty-input special case is realized uniformly: after
R8.5c counts the native input, the constant writer sets the first buffered cell
to `true`. The resulting word has length `logSpace n`, including at zero. A
Z1-hosted Catalog length counter emits its binary length and genuinely halts.
Both live exits are intercepted at their first visits. The space ledger includes
the native head intervals, the overwrite boundary, the virtual-input boundary
cells and the fresh bank, giving `A * (logSpace n + 1)` before absorption. -/
theorem spaceConstructible_logSpace : SpaceConstructible logSpace := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, M, hM⟩ := b3a_log_machine
  refine ⟨fun _ => le_rfl, 2 * A, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hs⟩ := hM x
  refine ⟨t, ht, hs.trans ?_⟩
  have hlog : logSpace x.length + 1 ≤ 2 * logSpace x.length := by
    unfold logSpace
    omega
  calc
    A * (logSpace x.length + 1) ≤ A * (2 * logSpace x.length) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hlog
    _ = (2 * A) * logSpace x.length := by ring

/-- **Linear space is constructible**: `n ↦ n + 1` is space-constructible (the
`+ 1` prevents the inherited zero-bound collapse at `n = 0` — the zero-bound
convention, `SpaceComplexity/ZeroSpace.lean` — and satisfies the dominance
conjunct; zero-space classes are nonempty, so this is about collapse, not
vacuity).

**Proof sketch.** The input-scan counter of
`Complexity.spaceConstructible_logSpace`, **initialized at `1`** so that after
`n` consumed symbols it holds `n + 1` (an uncorrected length counter holds `n`
and emits the wrong word); emit its bits. Space:
the counter's binary width plus fixed administrative cells fit in
`A·(n + 2) ≤ 2A·(n + 1)` visited cells; dominance is `logSpace n ≤ n + 1`
(`1 ≤ 1` at `n = 0`; a small arithmetic lemma otherwise).

**Fill appendix.** The counter initialized at `1` is realized by the Catalog
length counter on `true :: x`, using the proved prepend and buffered-composition
rows. Its linear running time bounds all visited work-tape cells, including
the counter width and boundary cells. -/
theorem spaceConstructible_linear : SpaceConstructible fun n => n + 1 := by
  refine ⟨logSpace_le_succ, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨P, a, hp, _⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_prepend_spaceUsed [true]
  obtain ⟨L, b, hl, _⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed
  let M := FinTM.bufferedCompTM P L
  refine ⟨M.k * (a + 2 * b + 4) + 1, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let t := a * (x.length + 1) + (x.length + 1) + 2 + b * (x.length + 2)
  refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [M, t] using FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime P L (hp x) (hl ([true] ++ x))
  · have ht : t + 1 ≤ (a + 2 * b + 4) * (x.length + 1) := by
      dsimp [t]
      ring_nf; omega
    calc
      M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (t + 1) :=
        M.tm.spaceUsed_le_mul_succ _ _
      _ ≤ M.k * ((a + 2 * b + 4) * (x.length + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ht
      _ ≤ (M.k * (a + 2 * b + 4) + 1) * (x.length + 1) := by
        rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ _)

/-- The tail transducer's transition: one bit of state, "the first bit has been read". -/
private def scp_tailδ : Bool → Bool → Bool := fun _ _ => true

/-- The tail transducer's emission: nothing on the first bit, the bit itself afterwards. -/
private def scp_tailO : Bool → Bool → Option Bool := fun q b => if q then some b else none

/-- After the first bit the tail transducer copies its input. -/
private theorem scp_transduce_copy (l : List Bool) : transduce scp_tailδ scp_tailO true l = l :=
  transduce_of_copy _ _ true (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) l

/-- From its start state the tail transducer computes `List.tail`. -/
private theorem scp_transduce_tail (x : List Bool) :
    transduce scp_tailδ scp_tailO false x = x.tail := by
  cases x with
  | nil => exact transduce_nil _ _ _
  | cons b l =>
    rw [transduce_cons]
    simp only [scp_tailO, scp_tailδ, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Option.toList_none,
      List.nil_append, scp_transduce_copy, List.tail_cons]

/-- The unary intermediate is short: `(|x.tail| + 1) ^ c ≤ |x| ^ c + 1`. -/
private theorem scp_tail_pow_le (c : ℕ) (x : List Bool) :
    (x.tail.length + 1) ^ c ≤ x.length ^ c + 1 := by
  cases x with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b l => simp

/-- The conditional's value: for `1 ≤ c`, the branch function is `x ↦ (|x| ^ c + 1).bits`
(`0 ^ c + 1 = 1` on the empty input; otherwise the count of `true :: 1ᴾ` with
`P = (|x.tail| + 1) ^ c = |x| ^ c`). -/
private theorem scp_value (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (x : List Bool) :
    (if decide (x = []) then Nat.bits 1
      else Nat.bits (true :: List.replicate (1 * (x.tail.length + 1) ^ c) true).length) =
      Nat.bits (x.length ^ c + 1) := by
  cases x with
  | nil =>
    simp only [decide_true, if_true, List.length_nil]
    rw [zero_pow (by omega), Nat.zero_add]
  | cons b l =>
    simp only [reduceCtorEq, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, List.length_cons,
      List.length_replicate, Nat.one_mul, List.tail_cons]

/-- The main branch's time, as arithmetic: with `P = (|x.tail| + 1) ^ c ≤ N + 1`, `N = |x| ^ c`,
and `|x.tail| ≤ |x|`, the four phases' exact times sum to at most
`(5c + 20 + 3c_L)(N + |x| + 1)`. -/
private theorem scp_time_arith (c cL t n P N : ℕ) (hP : P ≤ N + 1) (ht : t ≤ n) :
    n + 1 + t + 2 + (1 + 5 * c + 4) * P + P + 2 + (0 + 1 + P + 1) + (0 + 1 + P) + 2 +
      cL * (0 + 1 + P + 1) ≤ (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) * (N + n + 1) := by
  have h1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (1 + 5 * c + 4) hP
  have h2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cL hP
  nlinarith [h1, h2, Nat.zero_le (c * n), Nat.zero_le (cL * n), Nat.zero_le (cL * N),
    Nat.zero_le (c * N)]

/-- The conditional's time, as arithmetic: with `n ≤ N`, the bound
`c_M (c_D (n + 1) + max (c₁ (n + 1)) (K (N + n + 1)) + 1) + 1` is at most `A (N + 1)` for
`A = c_M (c_D + c₁ + 2K + 2) + 1`. -/
private theorem scp_space_arith (cM cD c₁ K n N : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) :
    cM * (cD * (n + 1) + max (c₁ * (n + 1)) (K * (N + n + 1)) + 1) + 1 ≤
      (cM * (cD + c₁ + 2 * K + 2) + 1) * (N + 1) := by
  have hmax : max (c₁ * (n + 1)) (K * (N + n + 1)) ≤ c₁ * (n + 1) + K * (N + n + 1) :=
    max_le_add_of_nonneg (Nat.zero_le _) (Nat.zero_le _)
  have e1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cD hn
  have e2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₁ hn
  have e3 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left K hn
  have hin : cD * (n + 1) + max (c₁ * (n + 1)) (K * (N + n + 1)) + 1 ≤
      (cD + c₁ + 2 * K + 2) * (N + 1) := by
    nlinarith [hmax, e1, e2, e3]
  have h4 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cM hin
  nlinarith [h4, Nat.zero_le (cM * (cD + c₁ + 2 * K + 2))]

/-- **Polynomial bounds are space-constructible** [AB09, p. 79]: for `1 ≤ c`, the normal-form
bound `n ^ c + 1` is `Complexity.SpaceConstructible`. (Degree zero is excluded: `n ^ 0 + 1 = 2`
fails the bundled `logSpace n ≤ S n` at large `n`; consumers route degree
zero through monotonicity into degree one.)

**Proof sketch.** Dominance: `logSpace n ≤ n + 1 ≤ n ^ c + 1` (`Complexity.logSpace_le_succ`,
and `n ≤ n ^ c` for `1 ≤ c`). The witness machine computes
`x ↦ (|x| ^ c + 1).bits` as a timed conditional on `x = []`
(`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond`, with the decider
`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_decideEq []`). On the empty input the constant
writer emits `(1).bits`, which is the value since `0 ^ c + 1 = 1`. Otherwise four phases run by
buffered composition (`Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime`), each at its exact time:
1. a two-state transducer drops the first bit (`Complexity.transducerTM_computes`; from its
   second state it copies, `Complexity.transduce_of_copy`);
2. the unary generator `polyUnaryTM 1 c` writes `(|x| - 1 + 1) ^ c = |x| ^ c` ones;
3. `prependTM [true]` adds one more;
4. the length counter emits the binary length `|x| ^ c + 1`.
The four times sum to `O(|x| ^ c + |x| + 1)`, because the unary word has length at most
`|x| ^ c + 1`, so the conditional halts within `A (|x| ^ c + 1)` steps for a constant `A`
(`|x| ≤ |x| ^ c`). Space follows from time: a `k`-tape machine visits at most `k (t + 1)`
work-tape cells in `t` steps (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_le_mul_succ`), which gives the
space constant `k A + 1`. -/
theorem spaceConstructible_poly (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) :
    SpaceConstructible fun n => n ^ c + 1 := by
  -- the published rows
  obtain ⟨L, cL, hL⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits
  obtain ⟨D, cD, hD'⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_decideEq []
  obtain ⟨K₁, c₁, hK₁⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_const (Nat.bits 1)
  let T := transducerTM scp_tailδ scp_tailO false
  let U := FinTM.polyUnaryTM 1 c
  let P := FinTM.prependTM [true]
  let N := FinTM.bufferedCompTM (FinTM.bufferedCompTM (FinTM.bufferedCompTM T U) P) L
  let f₂ : List Bool → List Bool := fun x =>
    Nat.bits (true :: List.replicate (1 * (x.tail.length + 1) ^ c) true).length
  -- the main branch, input by input: exact times of the four phases, composed
  have hN : N.ComputesFunInTime f₂ fun n => (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) * (n ^ c + n + 1) := by
    apply (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro x
    have hT : T.ComputesInTime x x.tail (x.length + 1) := by
      have h := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp
        (transducerTM_computes scp_tailδ scp_tailO false) x
      rwa [scp_transduce_tail] at h
    have hU := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp (FinTM.polyUnaryTM_computes 1 c) x.tail
    have hP := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp (FinTM.prependTM_computes [true])
      (List.replicate (1 * (x.tail.length + 1) ^ c) true)
    have hL' := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp hL
      ([true] ++ List.replicate (1 * (x.tail.length + 1) ^ c) true)
    have h₁ := FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime T U hT hU
    have h₂ := FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime _ P h₁ hP
    have h₃ := FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime _ L h₂ hL'
    apply h₃.mono
    have hp := scp_tail_pow_le c x
    have htl : x.tail.length ≤ x.length := by simp
    simp only [List.length_replicate, Nat.one_mul, List.length_append, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil]
    exact scp_time_arith c cL x.tail.length x.length _ _ hp htl
  obtain ⟨M, cM, hM⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond hD' hK₁ hN
  -- the value
  have hval : (fun x : List Bool => if decide (x = []) then Nat.bits 1 else f₂ x) =
      fun x => Nat.bits (x.length ^ c + 1) := by
    funext x
    exact scp_value c hc x
  rw [hval] at hM
  -- time, then space from time
  refine (spaceConstructible_iff _).mpr ⟨fun n => ?_,
    M.k * (cM * (cD + c₁ + 2 * (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) + 2) + 1) + 1, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := logSpace_le_succ n
    have h2 : n ≤ n ^ c := Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) n
    omega
  · apply (FinTM.computesInSpace_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro x
    refine ⟨_, (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp hM x, ?_⟩
    apply (MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_le_mul_succ _ _ _).trans
    have hB := scp_space_arith cM cD c₁ (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) x.length (x.length ^ c)
      (Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) x.length)
    calc M.k * (cM * (cD * (x.length + 1) + max (c₁ * (x.length + 1))
            ((5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) * (x.length ^ c + x.length + 1)) + 1) + 1)
        ≤ M.k * ((cM * (cD + c₁ + 2 * (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) + 2) + 1) * (x.length ^ c + 1)) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hB
      _ ≤ (M.k * (cM * (cD + c₁ + 2 * (5 * c + 20 + 3 * cL) + 2) + 1) + 1) *
            (x.length ^ c + 1) := by
        rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ _)

end Complexity
```

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Step

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The code languages

The languages a configuration-graph algorithm calls on codes of configurations of a fixed
machine `N` on its real input `x`, at window radius `s` [AB09, §4.1.1]. Each takes the input
`x`, one or two codes and the radius, laid out as the virtual input of a `whole`-mode call
of an abstract register machine whose registers hold the codes and the radius
(`Complexity.LogProg.vword`): `⟨x, ⟨bits c, bits s⟩⟩` or `⟨x, ⟨bits c, ⟨bits c', bits s⟩⟩⟩`.

* `Complexity.Codec.validLang N` — `c` is the code of a window-bounded configuration;
* `Complexity.Codec.initLang N` — `c` is the code of the initial configuration;
* `Complexity.Codec.acceptLang N` — `c` is the code of a halted window-bounded
  configuration with output `[true]` (acceptance as in `Turing.FinNDTM.AcceptsWithin`);
* `Complexity.Codec.stepLang N` — `c`, `c'` are codes of window-bounded configurations
  with an edge `Turing.NDTM.CfgStep` between them;
* `Complexity.Codec.edgeLang N` — `c` is the code of a window-bounded configuration with a
  work head on the window's boundary.

The finite checks on code words that the logspace deciders perform (`ValidChk`, `InitChk`,
`AcceptChk`, `StepChk`), and the reduction of membership to them, are in
`SpaceComplexity/Codec/Checks`.

Configuration-graph infrastructure; not a result of [AB09].

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.validLang`, `initLang`, `acceptLang`, `stepLang`, `edgeLang`.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.mem_validLang_iff`, `mem_initLang_iff`, `mem_acceptLang_iff`,
  `mem_stepLang_iff`, `mem_edgeLang_iff` — the defining equations of the languages.
* `Complexity.Codec.mem_codeLang_iff` — membership in a language of encoded triples.
* `Complexity.Codec.mem_validLang`, `mem_initLang`, `mem_acceptLang`, `mem_stepLang`,
  `mem_edgeLang` —
  membership through the codec.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

variable (N : FinNDTM Bool)

/-! ## The languages -/

/-- **Valid codes**: `⟨x, ⟨bits c, bits s⟩⟩` such that `c` is the code at radius `s` of a
window-bounded configuration of `N` on `x`. -/
def validLang : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ), y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
    ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c}

/-- **Initial codes**: `⟨x, ⟨bits c, bits s⟩⟩` such that `c` is the code at radius `s` of the
initial configuration of `N` on `x`. -/
def initLang : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ), y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
    cfgCode s (N.tm.initCfg x) = c}

/-- **Accepting codes**: `⟨x, ⟨bits c, bits s⟩⟩` such that `c` is the code at radius `s` of a
window-bounded configuration of `N` on `x` that is halted with output exactly `[true]`. -/
def acceptLang : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ), y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
    ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧ C.state = none ∧
      C.output = [true]}

/-- **Step pairs**: `⟨x, ⟨bits c, ⟨bits c', bits s⟩⟩⟩` such that `c` and `c'` are the codes at
radius `s` of window-bounded configurations of `N` on `x` joined by a configuration-graph
edge (one step under some choice bit). -/
def stepLang : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ (x : List Bool) (c c' s : ℕ),
    y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (pairEncode (Nat.bits c') (Nat.bits s))) ∧
    ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧
      ∃ C' : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, N.tm.CfgStep C C' ∧ Cfg.InWindow s C' ∧ cfgCode s C' = c'}

/-- **Edge codes**: `⟨x, ⟨bits c, bits s⟩⟩` such that `c` is the code at radius `s` of a
window-bounded configuration of `N` on `x` with some work head on the window's boundary, at
position `-s` or `s`. A configuration-graph search at radius `s` that reaches no edge code has
seen every reachable configuration. -/
def edgeLang : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ), y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
    ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧
      ∃ i, |C.workTapePos i| = (s : ℤ)}

/-- A word is in the valid-code language exactly when it encodes an input `x`, a code `c` and a
radius `s` such that `c` is the radius-`s` code of a configuration on `x` that stays in the window
of radius `s`. -/
lemma mem_validLang_iff (y : List Bool) :
    y ∈ validLang N ↔ ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ),
      y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c := Iff.rfl

/-- A word is in the initial-code language exactly when it encodes an input `x`, a code `c` and a
radius `s` such that `c` is the radius-`s` code of the initial configuration of `N` on `x`. -/
lemma mem_initLang_iff (y : List Bool) :
    y ∈ initLang N ↔ ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ),
      y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
      cfgCode s (N.tm.initCfg x) = c := Iff.rfl

/-- A word is in the accepting-code language exactly when it encodes an input `x`, a code `c` and
a radius `s` such that `c` is the radius-`s` code of a configuration on `x` that stays in the
window of radius `s`, is halted and has output exactly `[true]`. -/
lemma mem_acceptLang_iff (y : List Bool) :
    y ∈ acceptLang N ↔ ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ),
      y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧ C.state = none ∧
        C.output = [true] := Iff.rfl

/-- A word is in the step language exactly when it encodes an input `x`, two codes `c`, `c'` and a
radius `s` such that `c` and `c'` are the radius-`s` codes of configurations `C`, `C'` on `x` that
stay in the window of radius `s`, with a configuration-graph edge from `C` to `C'`. -/
lemma mem_stepLang_iff (y : List Bool) :
    y ∈ stepLang N ↔ ∃ (x : List Bool) (c c' s : ℕ),
      y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (pairEncode (Nat.bits c') (Nat.bits s))) ∧
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧
        ∃ C' : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, N.tm.CfgStep C C' ∧ Cfg.InWindow s C' ∧
          cfgCode s C' = c' := Iff.rfl

/-- A word is in the edge-code language exactly when it encodes an input `x`, a code `c` and a
radius `s` such that `c` is the radius-`s` code of a configuration on `x` that stays in the
window of radius `s` and has some work head at `-s` or `+s`. -/
lemma mem_edgeLang_iff (y : List Bool) :
    y ∈ edgeLang N ↔ ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ),
      y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧
        ∃ i, |C.workTapePos i| = (s : ℤ) := Iff.rfl

/-- The pairing is injective in both components. -/
lemma pairEncode_inj {a b a' b' : List Bool} (h : pairEncode a b = pairEncode a' b') :
    a = a' ∧ b = b' := by
  have := pairEncode_injective (show (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => pairEncode p.1 p.2) (a, b) =
    (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => pairEncode p.1 p.2) (a', b') from h)
  simpa using this

/-- **Membership in a language of encoded triples.** Let `L` be a language whose members are
exactly the encodings `⟨x, ⟨bits c, enc t⟩⟩` with `P x c t`, for an injective encoding `enc` of
the tail. Then for every word `w`, `⟨x, ⟨w, enc t⟩⟩ ∈ L` exactly when `w` is the binary word of
some `c` with `P x c t`. The code languages are of this shape: with tail `bits s` for
`validLang`, `initLang`, `acceptLang` and `edgeLang`, and with tail `⟨w', bits s⟩` for
`stepLang`.

Configuration-graph infrastructure ([AB09, §4.1.1]); not a result of [AB09].

**Proof sketch.** A member `⟨x', ⟨bits c, enc t'⟩⟩` equal to `⟨x, ⟨w, enc t⟩⟩` has `x' = x` and
`bits c = w` by injectivity of the pairing, in both layers, and `t' = t` by injectivity of `enc`.
Conversely `⟨x, ⟨bits c, enc t⟩⟩` is a member when `P x c t` holds. -/
theorem mem_codeLang_iff {τ : Type} {enc : τ → List Bool} (henc : Function.Injective enc)
    {L : Language Bool} {P : List Bool → ℕ → τ → Prop}
    (hL : ∀ y, y ∈ L ↔ ∃ (x : List Bool) (c : ℕ) (t : τ),
      y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (enc t)) ∧ P x c t)
    (x w : List Bool) (t : τ) :
    pairEncode x (pairEncode w (enc t)) ∈ L ↔ ∃ c, Nat.bits c = w ∧ P x c t := by
  rw [hL]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x', c, t', h, hP⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, h2⟩ := pairEncode_inj h
    obtain ⟨hw, ht⟩ := pairEncode_inj h2
    obtain rfl := henc ht
    exact ⟨c, hw.symm, hP⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl, hP⟩
    exact ⟨x, c, t, rfl, hP⟩

/-- **Membership in the valid-code language.** The encoding of `x`, `bits c` and `bits s` is in
the language exactly when `c` is the radius-`s` code of a configuration on `x` inside the window
of radius `s`. -/
theorem mem_validLang (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ) :
    pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ validLang N ↔
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c := by
  rw [mem_codeLang_iff bits_injective (mem_validLang_iff N)]
  simp only [bits_injective.eq_iff, exists_eq_left]

/-- **Membership in the initial-code language.** The encoding of `x`, `bits c` and `bits s` is in
the language exactly when `c` is the radius-`s` code of `N`'s initial configuration on `x`. -/
theorem mem_initLang (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ) :
    pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ initLang N ↔
      cfgCode s (N.tm.initCfg x) = c := by
  rw [mem_codeLang_iff bits_injective (mem_initLang_iff N)]
  simp only [bits_injective.eq_iff, exists_eq_left]

/-- **Membership in the accepting-code language.** The encoding of `x`, `bits c` and `bits s` is
in the language exactly when `c` is the radius-`s` code of a halted configuration on `x` inside
the window of radius `s` whose output is `[true]`. -/
theorem mem_acceptLang (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ) :
    pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ acceptLang N ↔
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧ C.state = none ∧
        C.output = [true] := by
  rw [mem_codeLang_iff bits_injective (mem_acceptLang_iff N)]
  simp only [bits_injective.eq_iff, exists_eq_left]

/-- **Membership in the step language.** The encoding of `x`, `bits c`, `bits c'` and `bits s` is
in the language exactly when `c` and `c'` are the radius-`s` codes of configurations on `x` inside
the window of radius `s`, the second reached from the first by one step of `N`. -/
theorem mem_stepLang (x : List Bool) (c c' s : ℕ) :
    pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (pairEncode (Nat.bits c') (Nat.bits s))) ∈
        stepLang N ↔
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧
        ∃ C' : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, N.tm.CfgStep C C' ∧ Cfg.InWindow s C' ∧
          cfgCode s C' = c' := by
  -- the tail `⟨bits c', bits s⟩` is the injective image of the pair `(c', s)`
  have henc : Function.Injective fun t : ℕ × ℕ => pairEncode (Nat.bits t.1) (Nat.bits t.2) :=
    fun t t' h => by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := pairEncode_inj h
      exact Prod.ext (bits_injective h1) (bits_injective h2)
  have hL : ∀ y, y ∈ stepLang N ↔ ∃ (x : List Bool) (c : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ),
      y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (pairEncode (Nat.bits t.1) (Nat.bits t.2))) ∧
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow t.2 C ∧ cfgCode t.2 C = c ∧
        ∃ C' : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, N.tm.CfgStep C C' ∧ Cfg.InWindow t.2 C' ∧
          cfgCode t.2 C' = t.1 := fun y => by
    rw [mem_stepLang_iff]
    simp only [Prod.exists]
  rw [mem_codeLang_iff henc hL x (Nat.bits c) (c', s)]
  simp only [bits_injective.eq_iff, exists_eq_left]

/-- **Membership in the edge-code language.** The encoding of `x`, `bits c` and `bits s` is in
the language exactly when `c` is the radius-`s` code of a configuration on `x` inside the window
of radius `s` with some work head at `-s` or `+s`. -/
theorem mem_edgeLang (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ) :
    pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ edgeLang N ↔
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Cfg.InWindow s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧
        ∃ i, |C.workTapePos i| = (s : ℤ) := by
  rw [mem_codeLang_iff bits_injective (mem_edgeLang_iff N)]
  simp only [bits_injective.eq_iff, exists_eq_left]

end Complexity.Codec
```

```
/-

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Sim

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The return phase of a subroutine call

The first half of `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Call`: compiled configurations
built from their blocks, and the return phase of a call — rewinding the input head and
moving every argument register head back to cell `0`.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.mkCfg` — a compiled configuration from its register and decider
  blocks.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.ret2_run` — the input rewind of the return.
* `Complexity.LogProg.retR_run` — restoring one argument register head.
* `Complexity.LogProg.regs_run` — restoring all argument register heads.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3, proof of Lemma 4.17.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

variable {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- A compiled configuration from its register block and decider block. -/
def mkCfg (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (rt : Fin m → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (rp : Fin m → ℤ) (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool) (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) (out : List Bool) :
    Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m) x :=
  ⟨st, ip, Fin.append rt dt, Fin.append rp dp, out⟩

/-- The configuration built by `mkCfg st …` is in state `st`. -/
@[simp] lemma mkCfg_state (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) rt rp
    (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool) dp out :
    (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out).state = st := rfl

/-- The configuration built by `mkCfg … ip …` has its input head at `ip`. -/
lemma mkCfg_inputPos (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) rt rp
    (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool) dp out :
    (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out).inputPos = ip := rfl

/-- The work tapes of `mkCfg` are the register tapes followed by the decider tapes. -/
lemma mkCfg_workTapes (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) rt rp
    (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool) dp out :
    (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out).workTapes = Fin.append rt dt := rfl

/-- The work-head positions of `mkCfg` are the register heads followed by the decider heads. -/
lemma mkCfg_workTapePos (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) rt rp
    (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool) (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) out :
    (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out).workTapePos = Fin.append rp dp := rfl

/-- The configuration built by `mkCfg … out` has output `out`. -/
lemma mkCfg_output (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) rt rp
    (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool) dp (out : List Bool) :
    (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out).output = out := rfl

/-- An action moving only the input head and register heads. -/
lemma apply_moves (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (rt : Fin m → ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : Fin m → ℤ) (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) (out : List Bool) (mvI : SignType) (f : Fin m → SignType)
    (st' : CSt Λ SD m) :
    (⟨mvI, Fin.append (fun r => (none, f r)) dIdle, none, some st'⟩ :
        Action (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m)).apply (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out) =
      mkCfg (some st') (moveInputPos ip mvI) rt (fun r => rp r + f r) dt dp out := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ (by simp [mkCfg])
  · funext i z
    refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp [mkCfg, dIdle]
  · funext i
    refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp [mkCfg, dIdle]

/-- An action moving one register head. -/
lemma apply_regMove (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (rt : Fin m → ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : Fin m → ℤ) (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) (out : List Bool) (r : Fin m) (mv : SignType) (st' : CSt Λ SD m) :
    (⟨0, Fin.append (regMove r mv) dIdle, none, some st'⟩ :
        Action (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m)).apply (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out) =
      mkCfg (some st') ip rt (Function.update rp r (rp r + mv)) dt dp out := by
  have := apply_moves st ip rt rp dt dp out 0 (fun r' => if r' = r then mv else 0) st'
  simp only [moveInputPos_zero] at this
  convert this using 2
  funext r'
  by_cases h : r' = r
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [h]

/-- An action moving only the input head. -/
lemma apply_inputOnly (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (rt : Fin m → ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : Fin m → ℤ) (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) (out : List Bool) (mvI : SignType) (st' : CSt Λ SD m) :
    (⟨mvI, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some st'⟩ : Action (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m)).apply
        (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out) =
      mkCfg (some st') (moveInputPos ip mvI) rt rp dt dp out := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ (by simp [mkCfg])
  · funext i z
    refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp [mkCfg]
  · funext i
    refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp [mkCfg]

/-- The seam of a program configuration as a `mkCfg`. -/
lemma seam_eq_mkCfg (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) :
    seam (kD := kD) (SD := SD) c = mkCfg (c.state.map .prog) c.inputPos c.workTapes
      c.workTapePos (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) c.output := rfl

/-! ## The return phase -/

section Return

variable (P : RProg m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)

/-- The input scan of the return: from position `j ≤ |x|` the head walks left to the left
blank and steps onto the first cell.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `j`. At a position `j > 0` the input symbol is a letter of the
input, so the head moves left and the state stays `ret2`; at position `0` the left blank sends
the head to position `1` and the machine enters the next return state. No work head moves. -/
lemma ret2_run (l : Λ) (cs : CallSpec m d Λ) (hcall : P.call l = some cs)
    (s : Fin (m + 1)) (dir b : Bool) (rt : Fin m → ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : Fin m → ℤ)
    (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool) (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) (out : List Bool) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)), ip.val = j → j ≤ x.length →
      (∀ t ≤ j + 1, ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (mkCfg (some (.ret2 l s dir b)) ip rt rp dt dp out) t).workTapePos =
        Fin.append rp dp) ∧
      (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (mkCfg (some (.ret2 l s dir b)) ip rt rp dt dp out)
          (j + 1) = mkCfg (some (nextRet cs l s dir b 0)) 1 rt rp dt dp out := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro ip hip _
    have hz : ip = 0 := Fin.ext hip
    have hstep : (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (mkCfg (some (.ret2 l s dir b)) ip rt rp dt dp out) =
        mkCfg (some (nextRet cs l s dir b 0)) 1 rt rp dt dp out := by
      unfold MultiTapeTM.step
      simp only [mkCfg_state]
      have hsym : (mkCfg (some (.ret2 l s dir b)) ip rt rp dt dp out :
          Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m) x).inputSymbol = none := by
        simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, mkCfg, hz]
      simp only [compileTM, ctr, hsym, hcall]
      rw [apply_inputOnly]
      congr 1
      rw [hz]; exact Fin.ext (by simp [moveInputPos])
    refine ⟨fun t ht => ?_, by simpa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one] using hstep⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
    · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      rfl
    · obtain rfl : t = 1 := by omega
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one] at hstep ⊢
      rw [hstep]; rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    intro ip hip hj
    have hsym : (mkCfg (some (.ret2 l s dir b)) ip rt rp dt dp out :
        Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m) x).inputSymbol = some x[j] :=
      inputSymbolInner j (by simp [mkCfg, hip]; omega) (by omega)
    have hstep : (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (mkCfg (some (.ret2 l s dir b)) ip rt rp dt dp out) =
        mkCfg (some (.ret2 l s dir b)) (moveInputPos ip (-1)) rt rp dt dp out := by
      unfold MultiTapeTM.step
      simp only [mkCfg_state]
      simp only [compileTM, ctr, hsym]
      rw [apply_inputOnly]
    have hval : (moveInputPos ip (-1)).val = j := by
      rw [show (-1 : SignType) = .neg from rfl, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]; omega
    obtain ⟨ihb, ihr⟩ := ih (moveInputPos ip (-1)) hval (by omega)
    refine ⟨fun t ht => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with h | h
      · subst h; rfl
      · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = t' + 1 := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hstep]
        exact ihb t' (by omega)
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hstep]
      exact ihr

/-- The left scan of an argument register in the return: from position `p ∈ [-1, |w|)` the
head walks left to the left blank `-1` and steps onto cell `0`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `n = p + 1`. While the head of register `rr` reads a letter of
`w` it moves left; at the left blank `-1` it moves right onto cell `0` and the machine enters
the next return state. Only that head moves, and it stays in `[-1, max p 0]`. -/
lemma retR_scan (l : Λ) (cs : CallSpec m d Λ) (hcall : P.call l = some cs)
    (s : Fin (m + 1)) (dir b : Bool) (a : Fin m) (w : List Bool) (rr : Fin m)
    (hrr : cs.args.getD a a = rr)
    (rt : Fin m → ℤ → Option Bool) (hrt : rt rr = FinTM.bufferTape w)
    (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool) (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (rp : Fin m → ℤ), rp (rr) + 1 = n → (n : ℤ) ≤ w.length →
      (∀ t ≤ n + 1, ∀ r, (((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp dt dp out) t).workTapePos
            (Fin.castAdd kD r) = rp r ∨
          (r = rr ∧ -1 ≤ ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
            (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp dt dp out) t).workTapePos
              (Fin.castAdd kD r) ∧ ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
            (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp dt dp out) t).workTapePos
              (Fin.castAdd kD r) ≤ max (rp r) 0)) ∧
        ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp dt dp out) t).workTapePos
            ∘ Fin.natAdd m = dp) ∧
      (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp dt dp out) (n + 1) =
        mkCfg (some (nextRet cs l s dir b (a.val + 1))) ip rt
          (Function.update rp (rr) 0) dt dp out := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro rp hp _
    have hpos : rp (rr) = -1 := by omega
    have hrd : (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp dt dp out :
        Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m) x).workTapeSymbols (Fin.castAdd kD (rr)) =
          none := by
      simp [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, mkCfg, hrt, hpos]
    have hstep : (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step
        (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp dt dp out) =
        mkCfg (some (nextRet cs l s dir b (a.val + 1))) ip rt
          (Function.update rp (rr) 0) dt dp out := by
      unfold MultiTapeTM.step
      simp only [mkCfg_state]
      simp only [compileTM, ctr, hcall, hrr, hrd, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [apply_regMove]
      congr 1
      rw [hpos]; simp
    refine ⟨fun t ht r => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
      · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
        exact ⟨Or.inl (by simp [mkCfg]), by funext i; simp [mkCfg]⟩
      · obtain rfl : t = 1 := by omega
        simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, hstep]
        refine ⟨?_, by funext i; simp [mkCfg]⟩
        by_cases hr : r = rr
        · subst hr; right; simp [mkCfg, hpos]
        · left; simp [mkCfg, hr]
    · simpa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one] using hstep
  | succ n ih =>
    intro rp hp hn
    have hpos : rp (rr) = n := by omega
    have hrd : (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp dt dp out :
        Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m) x).workTapeSymbols (Fin.castAdd kD (rr)) =
          some w[n] := by
      simp [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, mkCfg, hrt, hpos, FinTM.bufferTape,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show n < w.length by omega)]
    set rp' := Function.update rp (rr) (n - 1 : ℤ) with hrp'
    have hstep : (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step
        (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp dt dp out) =
        mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp' dt dp out := by
      unfold MultiTapeTM.step
      simp only [mkCfg_state]
      simp only [compileTM, ctr, hcall, hrr, hrd, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [apply_regMove]
      congr 1
      rw [hrp', hpos, sub_eq_add_neg]; simp
    obtain ⟨ihb, ihr⟩ := ih rp' (by simp [hrp']) (by omega)
    refine ⟨fun t ht r => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with h | h
      · subst h; exact ⟨Or.inl (by simp [mkCfg]), by funext i; simp [mkCfg]⟩
      · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = t' + 1 := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hstep]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihb t' (by omega) r
        refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
        by_cases hr : r = rr
        · subst hr
          right
          rcases h1 with h1 | h1
          · rw [h1]; simp [hrp', hpos]
          · refine ⟨rfl, h1.2.1, h1.2.2.trans ?_⟩
            simp only [hrp', Function.update_self, hpos]
            omega
        · left
          rcases h1 with h1 | h1
          · rw [h1]; simp [hrp', hr]
          · exact absurd h1.1 hr
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hstep, ihr]
      congr 1
      funext r
      by_cases hr : r = rr
      · subst hr; simp
      · simp [hrp', hr]

/-- The side test of the return phase for argument register number `a`. -/
def leftSide (s : Fin (m + 1)) (dir : Bool) (a : Fin m) : Bool :=
  decide (s.val < a.val + 1) || (decide (s.val = a.val + 1) && !dir)

/-- Restoring one argument register head: from any position in `[-1, |w|]` (a blank end
being identified by the side test) the head returns to cell `0`.

**Proof sketch.** If the head is on a letter, or on a blank identified as the left end by the
side test, the scan `retR_scan` applies (after at most one step right from `-1`). If it is on
the right blank `|w|`, one step moves it left onto the last letter and `retR_scan` applies from
there. In both cases only the head of `rr` moves, within `[-1, |w|]`. -/
lemma retR_run (l : Λ) (cs : CallSpec m d Λ) (hcall : P.call l = some cs)
    (s : Fin (m + 1)) (dir b : Bool) (a : Fin m) (w : List Bool) (rr : Fin m)
    (hrr : cs.args.getD a a = rr) (rt : Fin m → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (hrt : rt rr = FinTM.bufferTape w) (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool) (dp : Fin kD → ℤ)
    (out : List Bool) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (rp : Fin m → ℤ)
    (hp : -1 ≤ rp rr ∧ rp rr ≤ w.length) (hl : rp rr = -1 → leftSide s dir a = true)
    (hrgt : rp rr = w.length → leftSide s dir a = false) :
    ∃ T, (∀ t ≤ T, ∀ r, (((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a false)) ip rt rp dt dp out) t).workTapePos
            (Fin.castAdd kD r) = rp r ∨
          (r = rr ∧ -1 ≤ ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
            (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a false)) ip rt rp dt dp out) t).workTapePos
              (Fin.castAdd kD r) ∧ ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
            (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a false)) ip rt rp dt dp out) t).workTapePos
              (Fin.castAdd kD r) ≤ max (rp r) 0)) ∧
        ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a false)) ip rt rp dt dp out) t).workTapePos
            ∘ Fin.natAdd m = dp) ∧
      (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a false)) ip rt rp dt dp out) T =
        mkCfg (some (nextRet cs l s dir b (a.val + 1))) ip rt
          (Function.update rp rr 0) dt dp out := by
  have hread : (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a false)) ip rt rp dt dp out :
      Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m) x).workTapeSymbols (Fin.castAdd kD rr) =
        FinTM.bufferTape w (rp rr) := by
    simp [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, mkCfg, hrt]
  by_cases hm1 : rp rr = -1
  · -- on the left blank: one step right
    have hrd : FinTM.bufferTape w (rp rr) = none := by rw [hm1]; simp
    have hstep : (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step
        (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a false)) ip rt rp dt dp out) =
        mkCfg (some (nextRet cs l s dir b (a.val + 1))) ip rt
          (Function.update rp rr 0) dt dp out := by
      unfold MultiTapeTM.step
      simp only [mkCfg_state]
      have hls := hl hm1
      simp only [leftSide] at hls
      simp only [compileTM, ctr, hcall, hrr, hread, hrd, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, hls]
      rw [apply_regMove]
      congr 1
      rw [hm1]; simp
    refine ⟨1, fun t ht r => ?_, by simpa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one] using hstep⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
    · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact ⟨Or.inl (by simp [mkCfg]), by funext i; simp [mkCfg]⟩
    · obtain rfl : t = 1 := by omega
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, hstep]
      refine ⟨?_, by funext i; simp [mkCfg]⟩
      by_cases hr : r = rr
      · subst hr; right; simp [mkCfg, hm1]
      · left; simp [mkCfg, hr]
  · -- otherwise: one step left, then the left scan
    have hn : ∃ n : ℕ, rp rr = n := ⟨(rp rr).toNat, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hn
    have hside : FinTM.bufferTape w (rp rr) = none → leftSide s dir a = false := by
      intro hnone
      apply hrgt
      by_contra hne
      have hlt : n < w.length := by omega
      rw [hn] at hnone
      simp [FinTM.bufferTape, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at hnone
    set rp' := Function.update rp rr (rp rr - 1) with hrp'
    have hstep : (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step
        (mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a false)) ip rt rp dt dp out) =
        mkCfg (some (.retR l s dir b a true)) ip rt rp' dt dp out := by
      unfold MultiTapeTM.step
      simp only [mkCfg_state]
      simp only [compileTM, ctr, hcall, hrr, hread, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      cases hb : FinTM.bufferTape w (rp rr) with
      | none =>
        have hls := hside hb
        simp only [leftSide] at hls
        simp only [hls, ↓reduceIte, Bool.false_eq_true]
        rw [apply_regMove]
        congr 1
      | some _ =>
        simp only
        rw [apply_regMove]
        congr 1
    obtain ⟨hb, hr⟩ := retR_scan P l₀ D q0 l cs hcall s dir b a w rr hrr rt hrt dt dp out ip n rp'
      (by simp [hrp', hn]) (by omega)
    refine ⟨n + 1 + 1, fun t ht r => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with h | h
      · subst h; exact ⟨Or.inl (by simp [mkCfg]), by funext i; simp [mkCfg]⟩
      · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = t' + 1 := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hstep]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hb t' (by omega) r
        refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
        by_cases hrr' : r = rr
        · subst hrr'
          right
          rcases h1 with h1 | h1
          · rw [h1]; simp only [hrp', Function.update_self]
            exact ⟨trivial, by omega, by omega⟩
          · refine ⟨rfl, h1.2.1, h1.2.2.trans ?_⟩
            simp only [hrp', Function.update_self]
            omega
        · left
          rcases h1 with h1 | h1
          · rw [h1]; simp [hrp', hrr']
          · exact absurd h1.1 hrr'
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hstep, hr]
      congr 1
      simp [hrp']

/-- The register positions after restoring the first `a` argument registers. -/
def retPos (cs : CallSpec m d Λ) (rp0 : Fin m → ℤ) (a : ℕ) (r : Fin m) : ℤ :=
  if r ∈ cs.args ∧ cs.args.idxOf r < a then 0 else rp0 r

/-- An argument register among the first `a` is restored to the origin. -/
lemma retPos_of_lt (cs : CallSpec m d Λ) (rp0 : Fin m → ℤ) {a : ℕ} {r : Fin m}
    (hr : r ∈ cs.args) (h : cs.args.idxOf r < a) : retPos cs rp0 a r = 0 := if_pos ⟨hr, h⟩

/-- A register outside the call's arguments keeps its position. -/
lemma retPos_of_not_mem (cs : CallSpec m d Λ) (rp0 : Fin m → ℤ) (a : ℕ) {r : Fin m}
    (hr : r ∉ cs.args) : retPos cs rp0 a r = rp0 r := if_neg fun h => hr h.1

/-- An argument register not yet among the first `a` keeps its position. -/
lemma retPos_of_le (cs : CallSpec m d Λ) (rp0 : Fin m → ℤ) {a : ℕ} {r : Fin m}
    (h : a ≤ cs.args.idxOf r) : retPos cs rp0 a r = rp0 r := if_neg fun h' => by omega

/-- Register positions within the call's range: non-arguments untouched, argument `r` in
`[-1, |W r|]`. -/
def RegBox (cs : CallSpec m d Λ) (c0pos : Fin m → ℤ) (W : Fin m → List Bool)
    (p : Fin m → ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, (r ∉ cs.args → p r = c0pos r) ∧ (r ∈ cs.args → -1 ≤ p r ∧ p r ≤ (W r).length)

/-- `RegBox` unfolds to its per-register condition. -/
lemma regBox_iff {cs : CallSpec m d Λ} {c0pos : Fin m → ℤ} {W : Fin m → List Bool}
    {p : Fin m → ℤ} : RegBox cs c0pos W p ↔
      ∀ r, (r ∉ cs.args → p r = c0pos r) ∧ (r ∈ cs.args → -1 ≤ p r ∧ p r ≤ (W r).length) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Restoring all argument registers, one after the other.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the number `k` of argument registers still to restore. Each
register is restored by `retR_run`, whose side test is supplied by `hside`; the restored head is
at `0`, so the positions remain in the register box. When all are restored the machine returns
to the program state `yes` or `no` according to the answer `b`. -/
lemma regs_run (l : Λ) (cs : CallSpec m d Λ) (hcall : P.call l = some cs) (hnd : cs.args.Nodup)
    (s : Fin (m + 1)) (dir b : Bool) (W : Fin m → List Bool) (rt : Fin m → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (hrt : ∀ r ∈ cs.args, rt r = FinTM.bufferTape (W r)) (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) (out : List Bool) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (c0pos rp0 : Fin m → ℤ)
    (hbox : RegBox cs c0pos W rp0)
    (hside : ∀ (a : ℕ) (ha : a < cs.args.length) (hm : a < m),
      (rp0 cs.args[a] = -1 → leftSide s dir ⟨a, hm⟩ = true) ∧
      (rp0 cs.args[a] = (W cs.args[a]).length → leftSide s dir ⟨a, hm⟩ = false)) :
    ∀ k a, a + k = cs.args.length →
      ∃ T, (∀ t ≤ T, RegBox cs c0pos W (fun r => ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (mkCfg (some (nextRet cs l s dir b a)) ip rt (retPos cs rp0 a) dt dp out) t).workTapePos
            (Fin.castAdd kD r)) ∧
          ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (mkCfg (some (nextRet cs l s dir b a)) ip rt (retPos cs rp0 a) dt dp out) t).workTapePos
            ∘ Fin.natAdd m = dp) ∧
        (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (mkCfg (some (nextRet cs l s dir b a)) ip rt (retPos cs rp0 a) dt dp out) T =
          mkCfg (some (.prog (if b then cs.yes else cs.no))) ip rt
            (retPos cs rp0 cs.args.length) dt dp out := by
  have hlen : cs.args.length ≤ m := by simpa using hnd.length_le_card
  -- the positions at every stage stay in the box
  have hret : ∀ a, RegBox cs c0pos W (retPos cs rp0 a) := by
    intro a r
    refine ⟨fun hr => by simp [retPos, hr, (hbox r).1 hr], fun hr => ?_⟩
    unfold retPos
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    · exact (hbox r).2 hr
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro a ha
    have hna : ¬ (a < cs.args.length ∧ a < m) := by omega
    refine ⟨0, fun t ht => ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact ⟨fun r => by simpa [mkCfg] using hret a r, by funext i; simp [mkCfg]⟩
    · simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, nextRet, hna, ↓reduceDIte]
      rw [show a = cs.args.length by omega]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro a ha
    have hal : a < cs.args.length := by omega
    have ham : a < m := by omega
    have hnr : nextRet (SD := SD) cs l s dir b a = .retR l s dir b ⟨a, ham⟩ false := by
      simp [nextRet, hal, ham]
    set rr := cs.args[a] with hrrdef
    have hrr : cs.args.getD (⟨a, ham⟩ : Fin m).val ⟨a, ham⟩ = rr := by
      simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hal, hrrdef]
    have hmem : rr ∈ cs.args := List.getElem_mem hal
    have hidx : cs.args.idxOf rr = a := List.idxOf_getElem hnd a hal
    have hp0 : retPos cs rp0 a rr = rp0 rr := by simp [retPos, hidx]
    obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := hside a hal ham
    obtain ⟨T₁, hb₁, hr₁⟩ := retR_run P l₀ D q0 l cs hcall s dir b ⟨a, ham⟩ (W rr) rr hrr rt
      (hrt rr hmem) dt dp out ip (retPos cs rp0 a)
      (by rw [hp0]; exact (hbox rr).2 hmem) (by rw [hp0]; exact hs1) (by rw [hp0]; exact hs2)
    have hupd : Function.update (retPos cs rp0 a) rr 0 = retPos cs rp0 (a + 1) := by
      funext r
      by_cases hr : r = rr
      · subst hr; simp [retPos, hidx, hmem]
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hr]
        unfold retPos
        by_cases hm : r ∈ cs.args
        · have hne : cs.args.idxOf r ≠ a := by
            intro h; apply hr; rw [hrrdef]
            have := List.getElem_idxOf (List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hm)
            rw [← this]; congr 1
          simp only [hm, true_and]
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
        · simp [hm]
    rw [hupd] at hr₁
    obtain ⟨T₂, hb₂, hr₂⟩ := ih (a + 1) (by omega)
    refine ⟨T₁ + T₂, fun t ht => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hnr]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T₁ with h | h
      · have h1 := fun r => (hb₁ t h.le r).1
        have h2 := (hb₁ t h.le rr).2
        refine ⟨fun r => ⟨fun hr => ?_, fun hr => ?_⟩, by simpa using h2⟩
        · beta_reduce
          rcases h1 r with h1 | h1
          · rw [h1]; exact ((hret a) r).1 hr
          · exact absurd (h1.1 ▸ hmem) hr
        · beta_reduce
          rcases h1 r with h1 | h1
          · rw [h1]; exact ((hret a) r).2 hr
          · refine ⟨h1.2.1, h1.2.2.trans ?_⟩
            have := ((hret a) r).2 hr
            omega
      · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = T₁ + t' := ⟨t - T₁, by omega⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hr₁]
        exact hb₂ t' (by omega)
    · rw [hnr, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hr₁, hr₂]

end Return

end Complexity.LogProg
```

/-
